# fjordrun_function (Data Source)

A function as it is in one environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "function_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_function" "hello" {
  id             = var.function_id
  environment_id = var.environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Function ID.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID. Defaults to the project's default environment.

### Read-Only

- `config` (Attributes) Configuration in this environment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `connections` (List of String) IDs of services this one references.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `domains` (Attributes List) Domains in this environment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `function` (Attributes) Function settings in this environment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--function))
- `icon` (String) Icon.
- `kind` (String) `web`, `worker`, `cron`, `database`, `agent` or `function`.
- `latest_deployment` (Attributes) The latest deployment in this environment, if any. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--latest_deployment))
- `name` (String) Name.
- `private_hostname` (String) Hostname within the environment.
- `private_hostnames` (List of String) The short hostname, then the project-qualified one.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name.
- `source` (Attributes) Where the code or image comes from. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))
- `status` (String) Status in this environment.
- `tcp_proxies` (Attributes List) Public TCP ports in this environment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tcp_proxies))
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.
- `volume` (Attributes) Volume in this environment, if any. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume))
- `vpc` (Attributes) The environment's private network, if any. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc))
